executedSql: SELECT f.location_id AS "点位ID", l.latitude AS "纬度", l.longitude AS "经度", l.district AS "区县", l.street AS "街道", ROUND(AVG(f.capture_count), 2) AS "平均捕获量", COUNT(*) AS "监测次数", MIN(f.date_id) AS "最早日期", MAX(f.date_id) AS "最晚日期" FROM fact_monitoring f JOIN dim_location l ON f.location_id = l.location_id GROUP BY f.location_id, l.latitude, l.longitude, l.district, l.street ORDER BY "平均捕获量" DESC LIMIT 200
